services.desc: is moving your body between deliberate heat and deliberate cold, in rounds, in one sitting. Sauna, then cold plunge, then repeat. People have done a version of this for centuries. Here is how a session works and what the research does and does not support. A sauna round warms you through, raises your heart rate, and gets blood moving to the skin and muscles. We keep the sauna between 180 and 200 degrees Fahrenheit. A cold plunge round does the opposite fast: vessels tighten, breathing spikes, and your body runs a stress response.
